name: scicp
description: Real-time scripture presentation engine for church and worship services.

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=backend  && npm run dev --workspace=frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.prepare:training-hard-negatives: npm run export:training-pairs && npm run mine:hard-negatives --
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:shared && npm run test:frontend
scripts.check:prod: npm run build && npm run test && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.electron:dev: npm run build --workspace=frontend && cd electron && npm install && npx electron ..
scripts.electron:build: node scripts/sync-electron-deps.js && npm run build --workspace=frontend && electron-builder
scripts.electron:build:win: node scripts/sync-electron-deps.js && npm run build --workspace=frontend && electron-builder --win
scripts.electron:build:mac: node scripts/sync-electron-deps.js && npm run build --workspace=frontend && electron-builder --mac
scripts.electron:build:linux: node scripts/sync-electron-deps.js && npm run build --workspace=frontend && mkdir -p $HOME/electron-tmp-build && TMPDIR=$HOME/electron-tmp-build electron-builder --linux; rm -rf $HOME/electron-tmp-build

author: Scriptures in View
